# ligo_source (Data Source)

A source: a set of workloads, named by a SPIFFE ID regex.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ligo_source" "ledger_ci" {
  name = "ledger-ci"
}

output "owner" {
  # null when nobody owns the source (it is not managed by a pipeline)
  value = data.ligo_source.ledger_ci.managed_by
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the source.

### Read-Only

- `annotations` (Map of String) Free-form key-value text, not interpreted by ligo.
- `bindings` (Number) How many bindings use it.
- `description` (String) What it is.
- `display_name` (String) A name for people.
- `jurisdiction` (String) The jurisdiction, derived from the regex.
- `managed_by` (String) The SPIFFE ID of the automation that manages it (the lock); empty when nobody does.
- `pending_change_request_id` (String) A change request of it that is still pending, if any.
- `revision` (Number) The revision; an update must name it.
- `state` (String) ACTIVE, DEPRECATED or RETIRED.
- `svid_regex` (String) The SPIFFE ID regex.
- `trust_domain` (String) The trust domain of the SPIFFE IDs it matches.
- `visibility` (String) Who may see it in the catalog: the visibility mode.
